pbo_caveat: Raw invalid-contract returns only; the four-fold proxy is not CSCV and has no acceptance authority.

negative_controls.future_feature_reason: The control raises directly and does not exercise the candidate feature path.
negative_controls.placebo_reason: One shuffle and the deterministic parent both use invalid non-self-financing accounting.

implementation_contract_findings.evidence: D02-D06, N01, and the equal-weight benchmark apply unchanged target weights to every return while charging turnover only on target changes. Holdings drift, rebalance trades, exposure, turnover, costs, and returns are invalid.

D05 has 30 parent fill dates and D06 has 29 rebalance dates in the shared window; only 2025-12-22 overlaps. First dates are 2024-01-19 and 2024-01-02 respectively. D06 is not a matched timing ablation.
D01-D04 report maximum_symbol_weight=1.0 while the StrategySpec maximum is 0.4.
The preregistered D05_same_intraday_window benchmark is absent.
Raw return rows end 2026-07-16 while terminal liquidation is charged at the 2026-07-17 open.
The runner used a 0.95 DSR probability threshold that was not frozen in candidate-manifest.json.

sample_data_caveats: The daily and intraday panels are real Alpaca IEX snapshots through 2026-07-17, not fixtures.
IEX is a limited single-exchange feed and has no SIP or official-open parity.
No event packets or event-factor returns were used.
The formal forward epoch starts 2026-07-20 and has zero observations.

economic_review.assessment: These values are retained only to audit the failed R6 implementation and are not strategy-performance evidence.
